laws.title: Artifact is not claim
laws.rule: An evidence.artifact Record MUST represent an evidential source or captured occurrence and MUST NOT encode the conclusion that the artifact allegedly proves.

laws.title: Binding is not artifact
laws.rule: An evidence.binding Record MUST express an explicit relation between exact revisions and MUST NOT become the evidential source it references.

laws.title: Evidence kinds use R0.2 identity
laws.rule: Both R0.4 RecordKinds MUST use the logical identity, revision lineage, lifecycle and tombstone semantics frozen by R0.2.

laws.title: Evidence class is evidentially constitutive
laws.rule: An Evidence Artifact evidenceClass MUST remain unchanged across successors of the same logical Evidence Record.

laws.title: Provenance core is immutable
laws.rule: Origin, locator, observedAt and digest of one admitted Evidence Artifact MUST NOT be rewritten across successor revisions of that logical Evidence Record.

laws.title: Evidence requires an anchor
laws.rule: An Evidence Artifact MUST contain at least one provenance anchor through locator or digest and MUST NOT exist as provenance-free assertion text.

laws.title: Evidence facets are bounded
laws.rule: Every admitted Evidence facet MUST be permitted by the Evidence class/facet policy and MUST NOT be inferred merely from a title or locator.

laws.title: Content facets require digest
laws.rule: A facet that concerns captured content, state, execution or integrity MUST bind an immutable SHA-256 digest under the provenance policy.

laws.title: Occurrence facets require time
laws.rule: A facet that concerns an execution or observation occurrence MUST bind an explicit RFC3339 UTC observedAt timestamp under the provenance policy.

laws.title: Locator alone is not runtime proof
laws.rule: A URL, endpoint, repository path or deployment locator MUST NOT by itself be interpreted as evidence of runtime behavior, successful execution or current health.

laws.title: Bindings are historically pinned
laws.rule: Evidence bindings MUST reference one exact Evidence revision and one exact target revision through PinnedRecordRef values.

laws.title: Binding targets are bounded
laws.rule: R0.4 Evidence bindings MUST target only exact knowledge.claim or knowledge.experiment revisions until later contracts explicitly expand citation semantics.

laws.title: Binding facet must be admitted
laws.rule: An Evidence binding MUST use a facet present on the exact pinned Evidence Artifact revision and MUST fail closed on facet mismatch.

laws.title: Binding relation is explicit
laws.rule: A Binding relation MUST be exactly supports, contradicts or qualifies and MUST NOT be inferred from ordering, proximity, labels or UI presentation.

laws.title: Binding core is immutable
laws.rule: Relation, evidenceRef, targetRef and facet MUST remain unchanged across successors of one logical Evidence Binding; rebinding creates another Record.

laws.title: Current evaluation respects withdrawal
laws.rule: Current evidential projections MUST exclude Evidence Artifact or Binding Records whose current lifecycle is withdrawn or tombstoned while preserving their historical revisions.

laws.title: Disposition is mechanical not truth
laws.rule: The derived evidential disposition MUST summarize currently admissible bindings and MUST NOT automatically assign established, refuted, true or false status.

laws.title: No evidence by count
laws.rule: The number of Evidence Artifacts or Bindings MUST NOT by itself strengthen a Claim beyond their explicit facets, relations, scopes and provenance.

laws.title: Evidence payloads fail closed
laws.rule: R0.4 payloads MUST reject unknown fields, invalid classes, invalid facets, invalid provenance and malformed pinned references rather than silently admitting them.

laws.title: Later presentation remains separate
laws.rule: R0.4 MUST NOT define Publication citation UI, Architecture projection, visibility, maturity, route or language identity semantics assigned to later R0 cuts.

payload.scope: Exact Claim revision under authority-boundary verification.
payload.rationale: The captured test result exercises the stated authority boundary.
